name: Visual Puzzles
intro: VisualPuzzles是一个多模态基准测试，旨在评估大型模型的推理能力，同时尽量减少对领域特定知识的依赖。它包含1168个多样化的谜题，涵盖算法、类比、演绎、归纳和空间推理五种类别。该基准测试的问题主要来源于人工翻译的中国公务员考试逻辑推理题，旨在更清晰地评估模型在视觉推理方面的能力。
intro_en: VisualPuzzles is a multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate large models' reasoning abilities while minimizing reliance on domain-specific knowledge. It includes 1,168 diverse puzzles across five categories: algorithmic, analogy, deductive, inductive, and spatial reasoning. The questions are primarily sourced from manually translated Chinese civil service exam logic reasoning problems, aiming to more clearly assess models' visual reasoning capabilities.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.10342, Sections 2.2-2.3 (pp.3-4) and Section 3.1 (p.5); official project: https://neulab.github.io/VisualPuzzles/; official dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/neulab/VisualPuzzles.. Visual Puzzles combines online and textbook puzzles, manually translated logic questions from Chinese civil-service examinations, large-scale visual-data synthesis, and repurposed multimodal benchmarks. All items are normalized to four choices, filtered to remove advanced-math or domain-knowledge dependence and to require visual solvability, then repeatedly reviewed by humans for clarity, solvability, reasoning type, and difficulty. The final 1,168 items span five categories with counts 262/211/200/209/286, difficulty proportions 46/39/15%, and visual/text answer options 57/43%. Evaluation compares direct and chain-of-thought prompting, reporting the better result per model, with accuracy and a 70-student human baseline.
